text.en: Several long-term clients note that the salon owner genuinely loves animals and provides careful attention during grooming. However, one pet parent reported significant concern after observing their dog shaking with stress upon collection and hearing a staff member shout at an animal in the back. Reviewers recommend discussing handling preferences openly and observing pet reactions when booking appointments.

Pet owners consistently compliment the grooming results, noting that dogs look neat, clean, and attractively trimmed. Clients highlight meticulous attention to detail on challenging coats, including hairy Chihuahuas and German Shepherds. Reviewers appreciate that baths, nail clippings, and hair shaping are executed to a high standard, leaving pets looking well presented after each salon session.

Most reviewers describe the salon staff as welcoming, friendly, and hardworking, noting dependable service over multiple years of visits. In contrast, one visitor witnessed an employee losing patience and shouting loudly in the back area, raising concerns about handling during stressful moments. While general customer sentiment remains warm, reports of staff conduct can vary during busy working days.

q.en: Does Le Paws Pet Grooming Salon groom both dogs and cats?

a.en: Yes, the salon accommodates both dogs of various breeds and cats for bathing and haircut services.

q.en: What grooming services are provided at the salon?

a.en: Services include full bathing, breed styling, deshedding treatments, and routine nail trims.

q.en: What days of the week is Le Paws open for grooming?

a.en: The salon operates Tuesday through Saturday and remains closed on Sundays and Mondays.

q.en: How do clients evaluate the pricing at the salon?

a.en: Pet parents describe the rates as affordable and reasonable for comprehensive bathing and coat styling.
